name: Sibbechai
bio: Sibbechai the Hushathite was one of David's warriors who killed Saph (called Sippai in 1 Chronicles 20:4), another descendant of the giants, in a battle against the Philistines at Gob, called Gezer in 1 Chronicles 20:4 (2 Samuel 21:18; 1 Chronicles 20:4). He is also listed among David's mighty men (1 Chronicles 11:29; 27:11).
